summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K regarding its pending acquisition of Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. under a January 11, 2026 merger agreement. The transaction involves a two-step merger structure: first, Merger Sub 1 merges with Sun Country, making it a wholly owned subsidiary, then Sun Country merges into Merger Sub 2. Post-merger, Allegiant will expand its board by three seats, with Sun Country designees including CEO Jude Bricker and two other directors. An Advisory Services Agreement with Bricker for integration support at $26,250/month was also entered. The closing is subject to regulatory approvals and shareholder votes. The risk-arb spread reflects deal execution timing and antitrust clearance.
